notes:
Lead: Product + Platform team at Copperstrand evaluating Redwood as primary inference provider for product analytics features. Short notes / call snippets and POC details below.

- Background: Copperstrand builds a customer-facing product analytics suite (in-app help, automated summaries, search across event logs). They need a predictable inference runtime for chat-based insights + embeddings-backed search.
- Initial approach: start with Hosted API to validate models & prompts, then move to Dedicated (VPC) for production traffic and data isolation. Explicit ask: can we do warm handoff from Hosted to Dedicated without changing prompts/config?
- Performance targets: 95th pctl chat latency <120ms for short queries; embedding throughput ~200 qps during peak reporting windows; cold-starts acceptable for background batch jobs.
- Cost constraints: tight unit-cost target; finance asked for committed-capacity pricing and overage policy. Looking at 12–18 month committed ARR in the 75k-250k range.
- Model preference: open/quantized variants acceptable (LLaMA2-derived or similar). Want Redwood-verified performance profiles + suggested quantization/kv-cache configs.
- Routing/fallback requirement: auto-fallback to cheaper model variants during spikes; prefer transparent metrics when fallback happens.
- Data residency: primary customers in NA and EU; EU residency for certain customers — Redwood must show residency options or VPC region controls.
- Security: top concern for procurement. Legal/Security asked for: SOC2 Type II report, SSO/SAML integration details, audit logging granularity (per-request + token-level), retention controls (ability to set retention per-customer), KMS/HSM integration options, support for customer-managed keys, and evidence of pen-test within last 12 months.
- POC scope (agreed): 2-week validation using Hosted API with the customer's dataset (redacted), then a 3-day Dedicated smoke test in a demo VPC. Success criteria: model parity for top-10 prompts, acceptable latency under benchmark load, integration of SSO for internal tester accounts.
- Quote from VP Product: "We love the latency profile on Hosted — but we need iron-clad security and clear path to Dedicated before committing."
- Redlines / legal: they want a data processing addendum covering EU residency and stricter retention terms. Also negotiating SLA credits for Dedicated.
- Internal notes: SE Priya to prepare a security pack (SOC2 summary, pen-test stub, SAML SSO guide, audit log schema) and Dedicated pricing worksheet. AE Alex to get finance on a single-point estimate for committed capacity.
- Risks: If Redwood cannot demonstrate KMS/customer-managed keys or meet EU residency needs, Copperstrand will evaluate alternatives (Anthropic/AWS Bedrock).
- Next immediate actions: schedule security deep dive (infra + SRE) and share SOC2 + pen-test artifacts; provide Dedicated pricing worksheet and example VPC peering runbook.
